title: common
description: The grammar every wilanis document shares. A document is one JSON file whose $schema names its kind: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wilanis/wilanis-js/main/packages/core/schemas/<kind>.schema.json, or the alias @wilanis/<kind>.schema.json. Every reference is a path from the source root: @features/tasks/tasks.port.json, or through a project alias such as @tasks/tasks.port.json. Plugins are alias roots: @std, @http. An operation is path#operation. Values where an operation is called are written in one grammar: literals as they are, {{root.path}} to read.

ident.description: A field, input, operation, resolver or node identifier.

alias.description: An alias root: @ followed by a kebab-case name.

path.description: A document path from the root (@...) or an alias (@name/...), ending in .json.

opRef.description: path#operation: one operation of a port.

typeRef.description: A type: string, number, boolean, blob (a stored file, carried as a handle: id, contentType, size, filename; never the bytes), unknown, or the path of a shape; any of them followed by [] for a list of it. Native contracts may also write type (a field whose value is a type reference) and $T variables bound by such fields. No bare object, no bare array.

inlineObject.description: An object type written in place. Legal in contracts and inside shapes; a graph's in/out and a trigger's in/out name a shape.

open.description: Keys beyond fields: false (default), true (values unknown), or the type every extra value has.

field.description: One field of a shape or of a contract: its type, whether it is required (default true), what it means.

secret.description: Redacted in every report and log.

enum.description: For strings: the closed set of legal values.

binds.description: Native contracts only. On a field of type `type`: the variable its value binds, so returns can name it. On a string setting of a trigger kind: the variable its {name} placeholders bind, as an object of required strings, so the kind's context can name it.

static.description: The value must be a literal where the operation is called, never a read: the checker and the plugin's rules judge it (a connection, a content type). A field of type `type` is always static.

value.description: A value where an operation is called. Literals are written as they are: a string, a number, a boolean, a list or an object of values. A string may carry {{root.path}} templates: alone it takes that value and its type; embedded in text it is interpolated (scalars only). A path segment is .name, or ['a key'] for a key that is not an identifier. Roots in a graph node: in (the graph's input), const (a constant), a node id, a resolver name. In a binding delegation's in: in (the operation's accepts) and resolvers. In a trigger's fire.in: request.
